args.rationale: Successor exposure attaches to Halcyon for the Pellworth Canning asset purchase under Exception (1) Express agreement. Section 7.2 of the executed APA states the purchaser 'expressly assumes all product liability obligations of Seller, whether arising before or after Closing.' The consumer class claim over defective seams in cans Pellworth manufactured before closing is squarely a product liability claim of the seller, and the assumption clause covers exactly this class of liabilities. Per the firm rule memo, an assumption clause covering the relevant class of liabilities is sufficient by itself; no other factor is needed. The general rule therefore yields, and successor exposure attaches to the purchaser.
